answer_1.quote: We focus on Transformer because of its state-of-the-art performance on machine translation ... We conduct experiments on CoGnition dataset and perform human evaluation on the model results.

answer_2.quote: We report character-level BLEU scores using SacreBLEU to measure the overall translation performance. ... our automatic evaluation tool achieves a precision of 94.80% and a recall of 87.05%.

answer_4.quote: We mainly adopt human evaluation for the experiments of this paper (Section 5) for ensuring reliability of findings. Translators are asked to only focus on examining whether the compound itself is translated correctly or not, disregarding errors in context.
answer_4.guideline: Translators are asked to only focus on examining whether the compound itself is translated correctly or not, disregarding errors in context.
criteria: semantic completeness of all atoms in the compound
